svg.title: Figure 2 with layer counts and inferred embedding dimensions at every tick
svg.desc: Two original ternary plots from Godey and Artzi. Left: KV cache. Right: FLOPs. Each tick gives a layer count and an inferred embedding dimension or range. Axes sum to 39 layers; the gold star is 24, 10, 5.
svg.text: Dark tick = layers · gray Dᵢ = inferred embedding width (range if several designs share a tick)
★ chosen (24, 10, 5) · blue below Vanilla, red above · blank interior = infeasible allocation
D ranges are inferred from rounded size targets and Appendix B; “—” means no feasible design at that count.
Adapted from Godey & Artzi, arXiv:2608.09703v1, Fig. 2 · original plotted points unchanged · CC BY-SA 4.0
